bugs.what: Session ID format required stripping 's=' prefix; tool accepted s=g5-94315-mtj4a2re in new_game output but required g5-94315-mtj4a2re for act calls

confusions: Map layout between Antler Stake and Sodden Verge — described directions (shrine and tower E) didn't match available exits; had to backtrack to find correct route
Not immediately clear that there were two distinct ending paths (verses vs crown) until late exploration; early signposting of this choice would help
suggestions: Add cardinal directions or a persistent map system to clarify navigation in woodsy areas
Use more shortcut options like 'follow the trail north to the barrow' throughout the game to reduce backtracking fatigue
Highlight early that player can pursue either verses OR crown path, not both, to set expectations
Consider a one-line inventory display at top of each room for quick reference
